finding_taxonomy_review.defect: The public finding name can mean causal mechanism untested or not identified. The oracle instead scores it as the specific missing-economic-outcome scenario. All scenarios have mechanism_identified=false.
finding_taxonomy_review.review: Inspected terminal explanations explicitly limit causal claims and identify untested economic outcomes. These four code mismatches are not evidence of four causal overclaims.

converse_issue.review: No economic_link diagnostic was run. Code agreement does not establish that the agent discovered missing data. Do not credit verified data-gap detection.

required_next_version: Separate mechanism status NOT_IDENTIFIED or UNTESTED from diagnostic findings.
Use ECONOMIC_OUTCOME_UNAVAILABLE only with a cited NOT_COMPUTED economic_link result.
Report which diagnostics were not run separately from observed absence.
Do not reward universal noncausality disclaimers as scenario discovery.

baseline_review.review: The pooled relationship was uncertain and the budget did not reach the interaction diagnostic. INCONCLUSIVE is honest about tested evidence but misses the generating regime explanation; it is not proof that the checklist asserted a false causal theory.

baseline_redundancy_review.observation: The controls diagnostic also returns raw association. All nine host episodes skipped the standalone association diagnostic; the fixed reference includes it before controls.
baseline_redundancy_review.limitation: Checklist redundancy and ordering improvements are not separated from LLM-specific decision value.
baseline_redundancy_review.next_frozen_comparison: Include a lean fixed input_audit-controls-execution_cost-regime_interaction reference with the same validity stop and budgets.

interface_review.v1: Allowed conclusion and finding codes were not fully exposed to the host.
interface_review.v2: Allowed codes were exposed but the limitations string type was not explicit.
interface_review.v3: Full field types, enums and actionable rejection codes exposed; all nine host episodes terminated with zero invalid actions.
